title: lampranthus zeyheri
intro: Lampranthus zeyheri, commonly known as 'Flapjacks', is a succulent plant species native to South Africa. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lampranthus zeyheri include its ability to protect against radiation damage, stimulate collagen production, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
